Aisha (CS): Morning folks — quick async standup for adoption/escalation:
Aisha (CS): What I did: followed up with Greenline about missing assistant replies, collected sample payloads and headers, opened support ticket with their account team.
Aisha (CS): Blockers: routing rule v2-integrations seems to be dropping or delaying some messages for a small subset of customers (Greenline + 4 others). I can reproduce consistently with request id header `req-20250315-9a7`.
Aisha (CS): Today: need help from infra/eng-runtime to trace `req-20250315-9a7` and advise on rollback vs hotfix. If not resolved by 11:30 PT, we'll ask CS Manager to notify Greenline.

Jorge (SE): Can you paste the full request headers and a short cURL repro? I can trace in the router logs once I have X-Request-ID.

Aisha (CS): Repro below — request is to /v1/routing/dispatch
```bash
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req-20250315-9a7" \
  -d '{"customer_id": "greenline", "payload": "hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/routing/dispatch
```

Aisha (CS): Sample log snippet from Greenline webhook: ```
{"ts":"2025-03-15T16:02:11Z","req_id":"req-20250315-9a7","status":"timeout","backend":"rtr-12","lat_ms":15000}
```

Maya (Solutions): FYI Greenline is in renewal next week — we should avoid telling them not to worry unless we have a clear timeline. If we need to rollback, do we have a documented quick rollback plan for routing rules?

Aisha (CS): Yes — rollback command is small, we tested it last month. Snippet:
```bash
kubectl -n routing set image deployment/router router=image@sha256:abc123 --record
# or use console: Console > Routing > Rules > revert to v0.41.9
```

deploy-bot: Routing rule v2-integrations was deployed 2025-03-15T02:11Z (build 0.42.1). Manual rollback requires approvals from @eng-runtime and @security if config touches auth.

Sam (CSE): I can message Greenline's CSM to acknowledge we're investigating. Can you confirm no PII was logged/exposed in the sample payloads?

Aisha (CS): Confirmed — payloads are synthetic test messages from their QA team. No PII.

Jorge (SE): Quick trace: seeing repeated timeouts hitting router pod rtr-12 around the same window. I'll open an eng-runtime ticket and assign to @eng-runtime oncall. ETA ~2 hours for initial triage. If degraded further, we should flip to fallback rule `routing-v0-legacy`.

Jorge (SE): For triage, can you also grab a full `X-Trace-Id` if available and paste the raw response headers from the failing request? That speeds correlation.

Aisha (CS): Pasting response headers I got:
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2025 16:02:11 GMT
X-Request-ID: req-20250315-9a7
X-Trace-Id: trace-88b7
```

Jorge (SE): Got it — correlated to trace-88b7 in the ELK. Noting in ticket: router pod rtr-12 shows CPU spike then OOM kill on that timeframe. Suspect memory leak after v0.42.1.

Aisha (CS): Ok thanks. Next steps (action items):
- Jorge: open ticket + assign to eng-runtime oncall (in progress)
- Jorge: investigate rtr-12 memory profile and confirm rollback criteria
- Aisha: prep customer-facing message for Greenline (hold until we have ETA)
- Sam: stand by to notify CSM once we have an ETA
- Maya: prepare contingency fallback proposal for renewal call

Aisha (CS): If nobody flags a hard objection, I'm ok with rollback if eng-runtime confirms a regression. Please ping here when ticket is created so I can log it in the customer record. @Jorge (SE) any chance you can paste the ticket link in the thread?

Jorge (SE): Will do — creating ticket now. Link: https://issues.redwood-inference.internal/ENG-5421 (assigned to eng-runtime-oncall). :thumbsup:

Aisha (CS): Thanks all — I'll update Greenline once eng-runtime shares ETA. :pray:
